question: Should OpenClaw permit completed low-risk `allow-once` exec reviewer decisions to be reused for an exact current-payload match during one reviewer instance?
rationale: The optimization intentionally skips a fresh model security review for a later request, so the acceptable cache lifetime and approval semantics require explicit maintainer ownership after the key is made complete.

options.title: Allow exact-payload reuse
options.body: Approve a bounded per-instance cache only when every model-reviewed field matches and conservative or failed outcomes are never cached.

options.title: Require fresh reviews
options.body: Decline memoization and retain one model review for every exec request despite the repeated cost.

recommendation.title: Allow exact-payload reuse
recommendation.body: Approve a bounded per-instance cache only when every model-reviewed field matches and conservative or failed outcomes are never cached.
